prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a standalone PNG atmospheric background for the top of the conversation column in Ascend Studio, positioned absolutely behind existing text without taking layout space.
Input images: Image 1 is a composition reference only: use the very subtle opposing cool and warm open surfaces at the TOP OF THE MIDDLE conversation column. Do not reproduce any interface, text or other decorations. Image 2 is a color and thin translucent material reference only; do not copy spheres, bags, UI cards or literal objects.
Primary request: a single wide, low horizontal abstract atmosphere suggesting a two-way conversation. Two open, extremely thin transparent membrane surfaces approach and gently overlap, offset from one another at the center to suggest response and exchange.
Composition/framing: approximately 1536 by 512, wide landscape 3:1. The cool sheet enters from the left, the warm sheet enters from the right; their shallow open folds meet at the center. Remain low in height and expansive horizontally, with generous real transparency above and below. The colored membrane details gently dissolve outward in every direction, without a cut-off border. The center is airy and spacious.
Color palette: luminous pale cyan and lavender blue from the left, soft pink, coral and apricot yellow from the right, with gentle blended pastel gradients and a very light mint accent. Preserve some colorfulness while keeping alpha translucency very low.
Style/medium: refined soft abstract 3D thin-film refraction, ethereal and understated atmospheric background, like delicately layered transparent light.
Materials/textures: paper-thin transparent membranes, faint soft refractive edges and smooth pastel shifts, no physical thickness, no metallic reflection, no hard outlines.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel; no white rectangle, no shadowed panel, no gray checkerboard painted into the image.
Text: none.
Constraints: only abstract atmosphere, no UI or text. Very soft feathered silhouette fading into full transparency around all sides. This asset should be subtle behind conversation titles and text, not a dominant illustration. Open surfaces rather than closed loops.
Avoid: thick opaque solid waves or color bands, pearly spheres, balls, beads, jewelry rings, torus loops, actual chips or computer hardware, graphs, nodes, arrows, labels, icons, sharp outlines, rigid repeated geometric objects, long hard ribbon edges, typography, screenshots, borders, watermark.
placement_note: Absolute decorative backdrop only; intended width 100%, height about 170 CSS px; apply low CSS opacity plus a soft edge mask when integrating. No reserved layout area; no pointer interaction.
status: Generated asset for selected current concept; source copied without image editing.
